import os
from pathlib import Path
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Extend each row's rightmost non-background mark to the right edge in color 1."""
    from collections import Counter
    out = [list(row) for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]
        if marks:
            for c in range(marks[-1] + 1, len(row)):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
